tasks.title: Specify and test native issue type file input
tasks.description:
Result: Specify and add behavioral regressions for editing long custom issue types through a UTF-8 file. Scotty accepts up to 4 MiB but Windows cannot pass that text inline. The current native type accepts any nonempty string; keep that contract.

1. In research/specs/issue-editing-v1.md define additive update --issue-type-file PATH, with '-' selecting stdin. It is mutually exclusive with --issue-type, and only one of description, notes and type may read stdin. Resolve file text before scanning and before the transaction. Advertise optional issue_editing.issue_type_file=true without changing version1 or other declarations.
2. Add tests/issue_type_file.rs using this repository's existing CLI fixture conventions. Test an exact Unicode type exceeding 32 KiB with leading hyphens and line endings; combine type, description, notes and priority in one revision-guarded update and check one revision increment, priority reason and unchanged claim. Test stdin type, mutually exclusive sources and two stdin consumers, empty/missing/invalid-UTF8 files, stale revisions and missing claim credentials with unchanged records/history, no-op and dry-run preservation, and the existing scanner rejecting a synthetic secret in file text. Confirm capability true and help/schema expose the option. Use synthetic input only.
3. Leave implementation unchanged. Read the complete test/spec candidate twice after the final edit, checking that failures can distinguish unsupported input from setup errors. Publish the exact candidate commit for the separate executor and reviewer.

Completion: Tests encode the declared generic behavior, preserve existing checks, and compile in the separate red task. Return changed paths, candidate commit, test names, source baseline and any unresolved setup. Prerequisite type-plan-review supplies the accepted complete updated plan.

tasks.description:

2. Run cargo test --locked --test issue_type_file --no-run, retaining complete output and exit. If compilation fails, return the actual test error to its author; this does not establish the behavior failure.
3. Run cargo test --locked --test issue_type_file -- --test-threads=1 and retain the complete result. At least the successful file/stdin round-trip cases must fail because --issue-type-file is unavailable, while workspace creation and baseline CLI calls succeed. Do not weaken checks to manufacture an expected result.
4. Publish logs, exact source/test hashes, counts and exit codes. Existing running builds must be reconciled before starting another.

Keep scanning after resolution and before store access. Reuse opts.issue_type and the current IssueEdit call; do not add a second mutation service or change manifests.
